visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. Built from components/site/v3. Same place-type class as /cities/[slug]/types/[type].
competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow / Redfin community type filters. A dedicated community+type page with leftover/segment stats, the parent community atlas, and photographed listings of that type, instead of a search-results URL. Unique title, canonical, ItemList when listings exist. Breadcrumb is City then type, no Home.
note: Same composition as /cities/[slug]/types/[type], from that route's _v3 components plus this route's PlaceTypeFilm (shadcn-carousel import on the community _v3). H1 `{Type} in {Place}` is the only display line; the Atlas wears an eyebrow under it; one section-0 claim sentence with its source line, single-sourced on listing_tile_mv. A V3Carousel mode=rail of photographed listings follows Atlas in the fold with price+address+beds/baths/sqft on 800x600 plates. The page still reads the recorded boundary itself because the LIST depends on its pins (Sunriver: 52 listings by polygon, 0 by subdivision name, measured 2026-09-09); the Atlas re-reads the resort outline on its own streamed budget so one miss is not both. Communities with no trusted polygon and no resort GeoJSON (sunriver, brasada-ranch) render the standin's unavailable state instead of nothing. Unknown type notFound().

tasteReview.evaluator: npx tsx scripts/taste-evaluate.ts place-type-community --builder cursor-agent — grok-4.6 via cursor-cli, three scorings of tip shots at /communities/tetherow/types/single-family including carousel-open; Mini Tip Ready judge on Matthews Mini.

shotSpec.capture: first viewport + carousel-open via scripts/take-route-shots.mjs against tip c2b2de83a next dev :3027; scale 1, palette-quantized

tasteReview.beats: Tetherow.com (https://tetherow.com/) — this page wins on a live MLS count, asking-price band, and a named Oregon Data Share timestamp; it loses photography and place character. Zillow community pages still beat the first viewport on photographed listings.

defects.finding: The canvas is a pale gray plat: boundary, streets, and listing dots are the same cream-on-gray, so 18 for-sale marks do not read as a price story at 1440 or 375.
The $1,350,000–$3,999,995 band lives only in the claim sentence; the slider sits at the ceiling with no histogram, so scrubbing is chrome instead of the data.

Rest fold clips the rail to photo fragments; the open shots are two (desktop) or one (375) listing cards then a cream void, with no peek of the next plate and no 1 of N, so the shadcn rail never fills the viewport the demo occupies.

defects.section: 18 homes ask … for nine in ten
defects.finding: Nine in ten is unexplained next to a count of 18; a visitor cannot tell whether that is a percentile, a close rate, or leftover methodology.
Desktop exposes 541.703.3095; at 375 the fold has Sign in and a menu only, so call is not a one-path job from what is visible.
Title, canonical, and ItemList are not in these pixels, so SEO cannot be credited as improved; a prettier fold that only holds crawlables is not a rise.

tells: Missing states. — the LISTINGS ON THE MAP price scrubber is parked at Up to any price with no distribution, ticks, or filtered remainder, so the only visible state is the unfiltered set.
The stacked-section page. — first viewport is still claim block, then atlas block, then a clipped ON THE MARKET strip, three stacked regions with no change in density once the map eats the fold.
tasteReview.dullest: LISTINGS ON THE MAP: most of the first viewport is a washed-out plat whose dots you have to hunt for, while the actual houses are a clipped sliver under ON THE MARKET. That is choosing a faint GIS outline over the inventory.
tasteReview.verdict: demoMatch is true: carousel-open shows the shadcn prev/next rail with photographed cards, price, address, and specs, not a cream box that hid the control. The rest fold is still a pale Atlas occupying the screen, a ceiling-parked scrubber, and a clipped ON THE MARKET strip, which is why the tells are missing states and a stacked page. SEO is not evidenced in the shots so it is held, not risen; inventory facts exist on the open rail and in the claim but the first viewport still hides most listing plates.
tasteReview.rebaselineReason: rubricVersion differs (v1-2026-09-10 → v1-2026-09-12) and shotsHash differs (new carousel-open tip shots on SITE-107 tip c2b2de83a). First v1-2026-09-12 mark on open-state evidence; demoMatch true from judge.
